verdict.rationale: Skills are plain, readable markdown folders whose SKILL.md can be reviewed before use; the installer explicitly tells you to review them (probe-rt-1), and writing skills is framed as writing documentation (docs-15, docs-76). Activation is partly documented in the using-superpowers skill, which gives trigger examples ("Fix this bug" → systematic-debugging), invoke-before-acting rules and precedence (docs-16, docs-32, docs-77), and release notes describe behavior changes (docs-55, docs-41). However, skills auto-trigger with no action from you (gh-11, docs-7), and nothing shows that every skill states its own activation conditions. Missing for 10: evidence that each skill's frontmatter or docs declares when it activates (the probe only confirms a name field), a per-skill catalog of what each skill does and when it triggers, and independent corroboration that behavior is predictable from those docs.
